title: AssureX Claim Engine — Data Dictionary
description: Complete data dictionary for all 19 ML features, 15 database tables, and claim classes.

ml_features.description: 19 features used by Python ML model and GTM image model

product_age_months.description: Product age in months (days since purchase / 30.44)

remaining_warranty_days.description: Days remaining in warranty (max(0, expiry - today))

days_since_fault.description: Number of days since the fault was first noticed

claim_submission_delay_days.description: Days between fault occurrence and claim submission

purchase_price.description: Original product purchase price in Pakistani Rupees

repair_count.description: Number of prior repairs on the product

missing_doc_count.description: Number of mandatory documents not uploaded

serial_number_match.description: Serial number matches across all documents

had_unauthorized_repair.description: Any prior repair at unauthorized center

target_classes.valid_claim: Claim meets all warranty conditions; should be approved
target_classes.invalid_claim: Claim fails one or more hard-fail rules; should be rejected
target_classes.manual_review: Borderline case; requires human reviewer evaluation

final_decisions.Likely Valid: Both models predict valid + rules pass + high confidence
final_decisions.Likely Invalid: Hard fail rule triggered OR both models predict invalid
final_decisions.Manual Review Required: Model disagreement OR low confidence OR rule manual-review trigger

warranty_rule_types.hard_fail: Claim is definitively invalid — automatic rejection decision
warranty_rule_types.warning: Suspicious condition — flags for review but does not auto-reject
warranty_rule_types.manual_review: Ambiguous condition — routes claim to human reviewer
